scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a wooden sailing boat on blue water, looking toward a sunlit shore with hills and a small town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Jesus going across the Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias, in John 6:1. The boat, shoreline, and weather are artistic choices; the verse does not describe them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus reaches toward a seated ill man supported by a woman as a large crowd follows along a sunny lakeside path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of John 6:2: a large crowd followed Jesus because they were seeing the signs he was doing on those who were sick. The individual encounter and setting are artistic choices; the word glosses used are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and gestures among his disciples on a sunlit, flower-dotted rocky hillside. A path rises behind them, and a blue lake, village, and distant hills fill the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:3, in which Jesus goes up the mountain and sits there with his disciples; the landscape and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman and a child prepare flatbread in a stone courtyard beside baskets of herbs, while a lamb stands nearby and a path winds toward a sunlit village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The chapter's uncurated Berean Interlinear glosses describe Passover, the feast of the Jews, as near. This imagined household and its preparations evoke the approaching feast; the verse does not describe them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures while speaking with Philip on a grassy hillside as a large crowd approaches, with a lake and mountains beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:5, in which Jesus sees a great crowd coming and asks Philip where they can buy bread for the people to eat.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warm watercolor scene, Jesus speaks with an open gesture to a thoughtful Philip as they sit on a grassy hillside. A crowd approaches behind them, with a blue lake and mountains in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Jesus speaking to test Philip, while already knowing what he was about to do. The approaching crowd and question about bread come from the preceding verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Philip gestures toward a large crowd while speaking to Jesus on a grassy hillside above the Sea of Galilee; a small purse and loaf lie nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Philip explaining that even two hundred denarii worth of bread would not give each person in the crowd a little. The loaf and purse are visual additions, not details stated in John 6:7. The source word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Andrew gestures while speaking to Jesus on a grassy hillside overlooking the Sea of Galilee. Other disciples listen nearby, and a crowd approaches in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Andrew, whom John 6:8 identifies as Simon Peter's brother, speaking to Jesus. The appearances and visual details are imagined. The chapter file attributes its English token glosses to the Berean Interlinear Bible; they are not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A boy sits with a basket holding five barley loaves and two small fish while a thoughtful man gestures beside him, with a crowd spread across a sunlit lakeside hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the little boy with five barley loaves and two small fish in John 6:9; the crowd suggests the question of what these are for so many. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a large crowd of men reclining on a grassy hillside, with a lake and distant hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 6:10: Jesus asks for the people to recline in a place with much grass, and about five thousand men recline. The setting, appearances, and arrangement are imagined. The chapter's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible; they are uncurated and are not GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds a basket of loaves and offers bread to a reclining man while a crowd shares bread and fish on a flowered hillside near the water.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 6:11: after giving thanks, Jesus distributes the loaves and likewise fish to those reclining, as much as they wished. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation. The chapter identifies the English word glosses as Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward his disciples as they gather pieces of bread into a woven basket on a grassy hillside, with the crowd and a lake behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of John 6:12, when Jesus tells his disciples to gather the remaining fragments after the people have eaten their fill, so that nothing is lost. The setting and visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: On a sunny lakeside hillside, people gather pieces of bread into woven baskets: eleven baskets rest on the grass and another is carried by a man.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 6:13: twelve baskets are filled with fragments left from the five barley loaves after people had eaten. The verse relationship follows the chapter's Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man gestures toward Jesus among a crowd on a grassy lakeside hillside, with baskets of bread fragments in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene interprets John 6:14, when people speak of Jesus as the prophet after seeing the sign he performed. The baskets of bread fragments recall the feeding and gathering described in John 6:11-13. The English token glosses in the source are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus walks alone up a sunlit, rocky mountainside while a crowd gathers below, one person holding up a crown. A lake and hills lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus withdrawing to the mountain alone after realizing that the people intended to seize him and make him king. The crown and landscape are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Disciples walk down a rocky hillside toward a lakeshore, where boats rest in the warm light of sunset.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:16, in which Jesus' disciples go down to the sea as evening comes. The landscape, figures, and boats are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of disciples in a wooden boat crosses a moonlit lake, rowing toward the lights of a distant shore.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative illustration of John 6:17: the disciples cross the sea toward Capernaum after dark, before Jesus has come to them. The moon, distant lights, and details of the boat are artistic choices. The verse's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: People aboard a wooden sailing boat grip ropes and its sides as foaming waves surge around them beneath a dark sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: John 6:18 describes the sea becoming agitated as a strong wind blows. This imaginative scene places the disciples' boat from the preceding passage amid the waves; the visual details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At night, frightened disciples in a wooden rowing boat look toward Jesus, who is walking on the waves near them beneath a moonlit sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:19: after rowing about twenty-five or thirty stadia, the disciples see Jesus walking on the sea and coming near their boat, and they are frightened. Their appearance, the boat, and the moonlit setting are artistic choices. The scene is informed by the verse's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands on choppy moonlit water with open hands, addressing disciples who look toward him from a lantern-lit wooden boat.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:20, when Jesus reassures the disciples and tells them not to fear. John 6:18–19 supplies the setting of the wind, sea and boat. The chapter identifies its English token glosses as Berean Interlinear, not GBT-approved.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among welcoming disciples in a wooden fishing boat beside a rocky shore on a moonlit night.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene guided by the chapter's Berean Interlinear token glosses: the disciples are willing to receive Jesus into the boat, and the boat is at the land toward which they were going. The night and rough water recall the preceding verses; the figures and moonlit shore are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd in robes gathers beneath trees on the shore of a blue lake, talking and looking toward a single distant wooden boat near the opposite shore.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative view of the crowd on the next day as they consider the one boat and realize that the disciples had departed without Jesus. The distant boat's position and the crowd's gestures are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several wooden sailboats carrying people approach a rocky lakeshore where people watch beneath a tree, with a basket of bread in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts boats from Tiberias arriving near the place where people had eaten bread after the Lord gave thanks; the basket evokes that earlier meal.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A crowd in robes arrives in wooden boats beside a lakeside village; some step onto the rocky shore while others look toward the houses.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 6:24, in which the crowd travels by boat to Capernaum seeking Jesus after finding neither him nor his disciples. The appearance of the people and setting is artistic interpretation. The verse's English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands on a sunlit lakeshore as a man faces Him with open hands and several people look on; wooden boats, blue water, and a village appear behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 6:25, where the crowd finds Jesus on the other side of the sea and asks when He came there. The lakeshore setting, gestures, and appearances are artistic details. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a gathering beside the Sea of Galilee. Several people hold pieces of bread, and a nearly empty basket sits among them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 6:26, where Jesus says the people seek him because they ate the loaves and were satisfied rather than because they saw signs. The setting and visual details are artistic choices. The verse's English token glosses come from the Berean Interlinear; they are not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among listeners on a flowered hillside above a lake, holding out a loaf as sunlight falls around him; a basket of aging fruit and bread rests in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene for John 6:27 uses the offered loaf and aging food to suggest the contrast between perishable food and the enduring food the Son of Man gives for eternal life. The light on Jesus suggests the Father's seal on him. These are visual metaphors, not a literal account. The word glosses are the uncurated Berean Interlinear glosses associated with the Nestle 1904 text, not GBT-approved glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard overlooking a lake and hills, a man gestures with open hands toward Jesus while several people look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the question in John 6:28: the people ask Jesus what they should do to carry out the works of God. The setting and gestures are artistic choices, not details stated in the verse. The wording follows the verse's Berean Interlinear word glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, seated beneath a tree, speaks with an open hand to a circle of attentive listeners beside a lake. Boats, village buildings, and hills appear in the sunlit background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 6:29, where Jesus answers that the work of God is to believe in the one God sent. The lakeside setting and people's appearances are artistic choices. The English token glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, a man gestures with open hands toward a seated Jesus as several others look on.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:30, where people ask Jesus what sign and work he will perform so they may see and believe him. The setting, poses, and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Adults and children gather and eat small white pieces of manna from the rocky ground, carrying woven baskets beside a wilderness encampment at sunrise.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the ancestors' wilderness meal recalled in John 6:31, where the speakers say they ate manna and quote that bread from heaven was given to them.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits teaching a group beside a lake, raising his hand toward sunlight in the sky; a loaf rests in a basket nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Jesus' words in John 6:32: his Father gives the true bread from heaven, in contrast to Moses. The lakeside setting, gestures, and basket of bread are artistic interpretation, not details stated in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, lit by a shaft of sunlight, offers a round loaf to a child and other people gathered on a flower-filled hillside overlooking a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses Jesus offering bread and light descending from the sky to evoke John 6:33: the bread of God is the One coming down from heaven and giving life to the world. It is not a depiction of a specific event described in the verse. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone room, a man gestures with open hands toward Jesus as others listen; a loaf rests on a cloth-covered table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the people asking Jesus to give them this bread always in John 6:34. The setting and loaf are artistic choices; the verse does not describe them. The English token glosses come from the file's uncurated Berean Interlinear layer.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree and speaks with open hands to a group of attentive listeners. A loaf of bread, a clay pitcher and a cup rest on a low table, with a lake and village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates Jesus' words that he is the bread of life: the one who comes to him will not hunger, and the one who believes in him will not thirst. The bread and water vessel are visual reminders; the setting and objects are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus in cream and red robes gestures toward five listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard. They look at Him with questioning expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 6:36, where Jesus says His listeners have seen Him and yet do not believe. The courtyard and the listeners’ expressions are artistic choices, informed by the verse’s uncurated Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus, wearing a cream robe and red shawl, extends his arms toward a man reaching out to him on a sunlit path. Several people approach behind the man, with a lake and village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene shows Jesus welcoming someone who comes to him, reflecting his promise that all the Father gives him will come and that he will never cast out the one who comes. The English word glosses consulted are the uncurated Berean Interlinear glosses.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward sunlight in the sky while teaching a group on a hillside overlooking a lake and a stone village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 6:38, where Jesus says he came down from heaven to do the will of the One who sent him. The setting, listeners, and gesture are artistic choices. The source file's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit watercolor landscape, Jesus takes the hand of a woman rising beside an open rock-cut tomb while a group of men and women gathers around him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual meditation on John 6:39: Jesus preserves all that the One who sent him has given him and raises it on the last day. The figures and setting are artistic interpretation. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not a GBT-approved translation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus clasps the hand of a man rising beside an open rock-hewn tomb, while people watch among flowers in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative picture of the Father's will that those who behold and believe in the Son have eternal life, and of Jesus' promise to raise them on the last day.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a gathered group in a sunlit stone room while one listener whispers to another; a round loaf rests on the table.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering portrays the listeners grumbling about Jesus as he speaks. The loaf is a visual reminder of his statement that he is the bread that came down from heaven, not an additional action described in the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone village courtyard, four people in period robes look toward Jesus; one gestures toward him and another raises a hand toward the sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined conversation illustrates John 6:42: people question how Jesus, whom they identify as Joseph's son and whose father and mother they know, can say that he came down from heaven. The courtyard, gestures and sunlight are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a gathering in a sunlit stone courtyard while one man whispers to another and others listen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus answering the people and telling them not to grumble among one another in John 6:43. The setting and visual details are artistic choices; the source's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gently helps a man rise beside an open rock-hewn tomb, with warm dawn light crossing an olive-covered hillside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visual metaphor for John 6:44: heavenly light suggests the Father drawing a person to Jesus, and rising beside the tomb suggests Jesus’ promise to raise that person on the last day. This is not a claim that the pictured event was witnessed.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group of people walk toward Jesus along a sunlit Galilean path as he welcomes them with open hands. One person carries a rolled scroll.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 6:45: those who hear and learn from the Father come to Jesus. The sunlight and scroll are visual symbols, not details the verse describes.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits teaching a group of listeners in a sunlit stone room, looking upward and gesturing. An open doorway reveals a lake and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus teaching about the Father. John 6:46 says that no one has seen the Father except the One who is from God; the Father is not depicted.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and gestures while teaching several attentive listeners in a sunlit room; an olive tree and a village are visible through the open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes John 6:47's assurance that the one believing has eternal life. The sunlit olive tree suggests life; it is not a detail stated in the verse. The verse's English word glosses come from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures as he teaches four listeners around a low table with a round loaf and pottery in a sunlit stone courtyard overlooking a lakeside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a loaf as a visual reminder of Jesus' declaration that he is the bread of life. The particular courtyard, loaf, and listeners are artistic additions, not details specified in John 6:48.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A family eats pale manna in a sunlit wilderness camp while an elder sits thoughtfully beside a small mound of stones.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects John 6:49's words that the fathers ate manna in the wilderness and died. The stone mound suggests mortality without implying that the manna caused their deaths.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus offers torn bread to a seated listener holding a piece, while others gather on a sunlit hillside overlooking a lake.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses Jesus offering bread and light descending from the sky to evoke His words about the bread coming down from heaven, which one may eat and not die. The setting and gathering are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits among attentive listeners on a sunlit hillside, offering a broken loaf with one hand and placing the other over his heart. Golden light falls over greenery, a lake, distant hills, and a village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses bread, descending light, and Jesus' gesture to evoke John 6:51: he is the living bread from heaven and will give his flesh for the life of the world. The verse does not describe this particular gathering or action.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jewish listeners exchange questioning looks and open-handed gestures around Jesus, who stands calmly beside them, with a lakeside village in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the listeners arguing over how Jesus could give them flesh to eat, as reflected in the Berean Interlinear word glosses for John 6:52. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath a tree, gesturing as a group listens beside a lake. A broken loaf, a cup of red drink, and grapes rest on a cloth in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene for John 6:53: Jesus teaches while bread and a cup evoke his words that unless people eat the Son of Man's flesh and drink his blood, they have no life in themselves. The setting and objects are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: At sunrise, Jesus clasps a man's hand and helps him rise beside a rock-hewn tomb. The man holds bread, and a cup of red wine rests on a nearby stone.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses bread and a cup to evoke Jesus' words about eating his flesh and drinking his blood. Jesus helping the man rise evokes his promise of eternal life and of raising that person on the last day in John 6:54.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward himself as he speaks to listeners around a wooden table holding a broken loaf and a cup of red wine, in a sunlit room overlooking a distant lakeside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses bread and a cup to evoke Jesus' words in John 6:55: his flesh is true food and his blood is true drink. The verse itself does not describe this particular gathering.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits with his arm around a disciple who holds broken bread and a cup of red wine, at a table in a sunlit stone courtyard overlooking a lake.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined meal uses bread and a cup to evoke Jesus' words about eating his flesh and drinking his blood, while the closeness of Jesus and the disciple suggests his promise of mutual abiding. The verse does not describe this particular meal.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus holds bread and gestures toward a listener holding a piece near his mouth in a sunlit stone courtyard overlooking a lake.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses bread and sunlight to evoke John 6:57: Jesus says the living Father sent him and he lives because of the Father, and the one feeding on him will live because of him. The setting and gestures are artistic choices. The chapter's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear and are not a Global Bible Tools approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus teaches a group beneath a tree, gesturing toward the sunlit sky. A loaf rests on a low table, with stone tombs visible in the distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the loaf, sunlight, living tree, and distant tombs to evoke Jesus's contrast in John 6:58: the fathers ate and died, while the one who eats this bread will live into the age. The scene is a visual interpretation, not a recorded description of this moment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and gestures as he teaches a gathering in a sunlit stone interior; buildings and water appear beyond the columns.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum, as described in John 6:59; the listeners and setting details are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Several disciples sit together in a sunlit stone room, one gesturing with open hands as others look troubled; Jesus teaches at a wooden stand in the background.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the disciples' response in John 6:60: after hearing Jesus, many describe the word as difficult and ask who can hear it. The synagogue at Capernaum follows the setting in John 6:59. The local English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not a Global Bible Tools approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone hall, speaking with an open hand to His disciples; two whisper together while others listen with troubled expressions.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 6:61: knowing His disciples are grumbling about His teaching, Jesus asks whether it offends them. The setting and appearances are artistic choices. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus rises amid golden clouds as people on a hillside look up toward him; a lake and village lie in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative visualization of Jesus' question in John 6:62 about seeing the Son of Man ascend to where he was before, not a claim that this scene occurred at that moment. The English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree, speaking with open hands to a small group of listeners in a sunlit stone courtyard, with fresh greenery and a blue lake beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imagined teaching scene inspired by John 6:63. The listeners and fresh greenery evoke Jesus' words that the Spirit gives life and that the words he has spoken are spirit and life. The verse's contrast with flesh that profits nothing is not depicted literally. The English word glosses used as guidance are from the uncurated Berean Interlinear, not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to a circle of listeners in a sunlit stone room; several look uncertain while one man stands apart, turned away.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene inspired by John 6:64, where Jesus knows from the beginning who does not believe and who will betray him. The setting, gestures, and expressions are artistic interpretation. The source's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear, not a GBT approval.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits and speaks to a man standing with open hands beneath a shaft of golden light, while others listen in a stone courtyard overlooking Galilean hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene for John 6:65 uses the light to suggest the Father's granting of a person's coming to Jesus as Jesus teaches his listeners. The verse's English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward a group of disciples walking away along a sunlit path, while a few remain with Him among rocks and olive trees above a lakeside village.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene illustrates John 6:66, where many of Jesus' disciples went back and no longer walked with Him. The setting, people, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits in a sunlit stone courtyard, extending an open hand as twelve disciples gather around him; a path winds toward distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined scene depicts Jesus asking the Twelve whether they also wish to go away in John 6:67. The courtyard, gestures, and landscape are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit stone courtyard, Simon Peter sits and gestures with an open hand toward Jesus as nearby disciples listen; several figures walk away in the distance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts John 6:68, where Peter asks to whom they would go and says Jesus has the words of eternal life. The setting and gestures are imagined; the departing figures evoke the preceding verses. English word glosses are from the Berean Interlinear Bible.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Peter gestures toward Jesus as several disciples gather around them beside the Sea of Galilee, with stone buildings, fishing boats, and hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of Peter speaking for the disciples as they confess that they have believed and known Jesus to be the Holy One of God in John 6:69. The lakeside setting and appearances are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus sits beneath an olive tree, speaking with open hands to twelve attentive disciples on a rocky hillside, with a village and distant hills behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined gathering illustrates Jesus asking the Twelve whether he chose them and saying that one of them is a devil. The setting and shadow are artistic details, and the scene does not identify an individual.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures toward seated disciples in a sunlit stone courtyard, while a thoughtful Judas sits slightly apart on a step beneath olive branches.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus speaking with disciples, with Judas set apart in quiet reflection. The verse identifies Judas, son of Simon Iscariot, as one of the Twelve who was about to betray him; the illustration does not show all twelve disciples.

icons_chirho.contextual_meaning_chirho: Tiberias, in the sea’s alternate name
